name: screen-dimmer
description: Always-on-top semi-transparent overlay that dims a part of the screen

scripts.postpackage: for a in dist/*/"Screen Dimmer.app"; do codesign --force --deep --sign - "$a"; done
scripts.zip: cd dist && for a in arm64 x64; do ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent "Screen Dimmer-darwin-$a/Screen Dimmer.app" "Screen-Dimmer-$npm_package_version-mac-$a.zip"; done
scripts.install-app: npm run package && rm -rf "/Applications/Screen Dimmer.app" && cp -R "dist/Screen Dimmer-darwin-$(uname -m | sed s/x86_64/x64/)/Screen Dimmer.app" /Applications/
